children.text: How you present yourself during your US consulate interview matters. On average, the interview lasts 30 seconds to 2 minutes. Visual impression carries significant weight.

In most cases, people prefer smart casual - a relaxed business style. This is, on one hand, appropriate for a formal meeting, and also relatively comfortable for someone who favors a casual style. However, this style isn't suitable for everyone.
Never wear clothing that makes you feel uncomfortable. Worrying about your outfit during the interview can distract you from conducting the interview smoothly.
If you wear classic clothing every day and feel comfortable in it, then you can dress classically, for example in a suit.
What you've stated on your
DS-160 application form

matters a great deal. If you indicated that you're going to the US "for shopping," it's important that your style matches this - wear recognizable pieces from your favorite brands, and look fashionable.
If you're going to a festival, and during the interview you mention that you've traveled to many countries, dress casually - as you would when heading off on a trip.

For those traveling to the beach every year, and for those who tell the consular officer they're going to Miami Beach for the seaside, it's advisable to have a tan (sun-kissed skin) at the time of the interview as well.
It's advisable to wear an accessory that reflects your style. For example, something valuable:
⌚️ A watch
📿 A necklace
💍 A ring, etc.
This emphasizes that you also have the funds to travel to the US.
During the interview with the consular officer, the consul sees your upper body. So keep your hairstyle and your fingernails groomed and looking consistent with your style.

For security reasons, you are not allowed to bring bags, electronic devices, or similar items into the consulate. Such items must be left outside with your companion or at a facility near the consulate. You'll need to pay a fee to leave your items there. In many cases, card payment isn't accepted, so bring cash with you.

It's important to feel as comfortable as possible in the clothing you choose. Your mind should be focused on the interview - on what the consular officer asks you and how you should answer. Don't wear clothing that makes you uncomfortable. This can interfere with your interview, since your mind will be focused on your clothing instead of the interview.
